Machine learning with AutoGluon, an open source AutoML library | Amazon Web Services

If you work in data science, you might think that the hardest thing about machine learning is not knowing when you’ll be done. You start with a problem, a dataset, and an idea about how to solve it, but you never know whether your approach is going to work until later, after you’ve wasted time.

https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/opensource/machine-learning-with-autogluon-an-open-source-automl-library/

](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/opensource/machine-learning-with-autogluon-an-open-source-automl-library/)

ML Life Cycle - Trial & Error & Iteration

  • Start with a simple model and once it’s working, try out more advanced models during many iterations

  • What if we combine multiple models to find the best answer? → Ensemble Learning

  • What if we automatically prep data and train try all eligible(적격) models? → AutoML (AutoGluon)

Ensemble

  • 여러개의 ML model의 예측을 결합 (combine)

    • 이 때 사용되는 model을 base estimators라고 함

    • ML + Decision Trees + Linear Regression + …

Ensembling the Data

  • Heatmap : price level (light color → higher color)

  • Decision Tree : Rectangular decision areas

  • Decision Tree produces below

  • Mutliple trees → Each tree gives slightly predictions

  • Ensembel model return the average outcome of 4 trees

Advantage & Disadvatage

  • Advantage

    • 단일 모델보다 우수 → 학습이 어려운 모델에 대해 각각의 예측은 좋지 않을 수 있지만 전반적으로 정확도를 향상 시킬 수 있음 (boost accuracy)

    • 개별 모델의 불안정성을 평균화 → overfitting 감소

  • Disadvantage

    • 학습 과정이 길어지고 더 많은 리소스가 필요

    • 단일 모델 보다 해석이 어려워 짐

AutoML

  • Codification (코드화) of the best ML practices

  • 자동화 목표 (Goal)

    • Pre-process : 데이타 타입에 따라 전처리

    • Split : train, validation, test

    • Find model : 최고 성능 모델과 모델 결합

    • Find parameter : 최고 모델 parameter

AutoML Framework

  • AutoWEKA, Auto-sklearn, Auto-PyTorch

  • AutoGluon : multi-layer stacking of diverse ML models

  • H2O AutoML

  • MLBoX

  • TPOT

  • TransmogrifAI

Hyperparameter

  • 학습 과정에 영향을 주는 알고리즘의 조정 가능한 parameter

Decison Tree Hyperparameter

  • Decision Tree : simple chained if-then statements

  • Max depth, max number of splits, min sample

AutoGluon

Principle

  • Simplicity : data와 ML model에 대해 자세히 알지 못해도 학습 할 수 있도록

  • Robustness : 다양한 데이터셋을 사용하고 개별 ML model이 실패해도 학습 될 수 있도록

  • Predictive Timing : 시간과 예산이 제한된 사용자에게 결과를 전달 할 수 있도록

How works

  • Model ensembling via multi-layer stacking

  • Thoughtful data preprocessing & data prep

  • Greater emphasis on modern deep learning techniques

  • Less emphasis on hyperparameter optimization

Multi-Stack Layer

  • Each layer is an ensemble model that is made of base estimators

  • 1st layer : input

  • 2nd layer : 이전 layer의 잘못을 학습하여 개선

  • Final layer : 각 모델에 대해 weight를 할당

K-fold Cross Validation

  • AutoGluon use repeated k-fold cross validation

Robust Model Selection & Training

  • AutoGluon anticipates and handles model training failures automatically

  • estimates future memory usage of individual models

  • skips expensive models

  • only loads one model into memory at a time

  • fails on far fewer datasets compared to other AutoML

    • label column에 대한 예측

  • fit 함수

    • Raw 데이터를 전 처리 : 각 feature를 식별하고 수치화

    • 예측 문제에 대한 type을 식별 : binary/multi-class classification, regression, …

    • 데이터를 split : k-fold split, disjoint training/validation set

    • 다양한 base model을 각각 학습 → 최적화된 ensemble을 생성

AutoGluon Result

  • score_val

    • validation score of the model

    • Metrics scores always show in higher is better form

  • log_loss

    • Cross Entropy : -tlog(f(s)) → red graph

    • Metrics such as log_loss and root_mean_squared_error will have their signs FLIPPED → green graph

    • To avoid the user needing to know the metric to understand if higher is better when looking at leaderboard

    • 확률이 100% 이면 → log(1) = 0

    • 확률이 20%, 40% 이면 → log(0.2) < log(0.4)

    • 확률이 100%에 가까워질 수록 0에 수렴하며, 확률이 높으면 score가 커진다

Advanced AutoGluon

Explainability - Feature Importance Score

  • Reference - RCF feature Importance

  • What is

    • the performance drop

    • when the model makes predictions on a perturbed (교란된) copy of the dataset

    • where this feature’s values have been randomly shuffled across rows

    • ex) A feature score of 0.01 → the predictive performance dropped by 0.01 when the feature was randomly shuffled

  • The higher the score a feature has, the more important it is to the model’s performance

    • a feature has a negative score

      • the feature is likely harmful to the final model

      • a model trained without that feature would be expected to achieve a better predictive performance

  • result

Identifying ML Opportunities

ML Decision Questions

When to use ML

  • Complex Logic

    • problem is too difficult to work with hand-code rules

    • underlying data itself can be difficult to understand (such as text, images)

    • there are many different factors to consider

    • have hundreds or thousands of features or a particular niche domain

  • Scalability

    • need to create a large number of predictions

    • need to do it millions of billions of times : training an ML model to perform that task, and then deploying it at scale

  • Adaptability

    • have to adapt to new unseen data

  • Responsiveness

    • provide good customer experience : product recommendations

Use Cases

Backfilling missing attributes in the Amazon Catalog

  • Problem

    • For many products in the Amazon Catalog, attributes (e.g. color, size) are missing or incorrect

    • loses customer trust when product results don’t match what a customer is looking for

  • How

    • predict attributes from product images → backfill the attributes

Sentimental Analysis

MLDQs to problem

  • What makes this problem it suitable for Machine Learning?

  • What business goal can be achieved by building a ML solution to tackle this problem?

  • What kind of ML model (regression/classification/clustering?) can solve this problem?

  • What data might be necessary to address this problem? Is the data already available & relevant?

  • What metric should be used to evaluate the model?
